_note: M2W1: the world kit's Blender looks (tools/blender/m2w1_world_kit.py writes glb; scripts/visual/world_kit_meshes.gd loads it). types.<type>: node = the near mesh's node in glb, lod1_node = the far mesh's, lod_swap_m = every piece of a batch is drawn near at least out to this camera distance and far beyond it (MapChunks LOD pairs; the far batch ends where the structure class says). A type without an entry, or with a missing glb or node, keeps its kit look (data/maps/alesia_structures.json parts). The switch is data/graphics_presets.json art_world_kit_enabled.
_fit_note: tests/test_m2w1_world_kit.gd: every vertex of a near and a far mesh lies within fit_tolerance_m of its type's colliders (what you see is what blocks), no vertex lies deeper than fit_tolerance_m inside an open volume, and no vertex inside a walk surface's footprint (shrunk by walk_edge_m) lies between walk_clear_m and walk_head_m above it (nothing to trip over or walk into).
_joint_note: Wall pieces of one side overlap 0.5 to 1.4 m (centres 6.6 to 7.5 m apart on alesia_1km). The script skews every wall piece a little so overlapping faces never share a plane (no z-fighting): a point moves by offset_m * clamp(x / half_length_m, -1, 1) * f, f = min(y / y_knee_m, 1) up and clamp(z / z_knee_m, -1, 1) sideways.

budgets._note: Triangle caps (placeholders): near per type, far per type, and the triangles of the structure batches in range at the four perf points of tests/test_alesia_1km.gd (instances x mesh triangles).
